xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012025-04-215-39-40" status="finalized"><note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3840">kha 1</rs> na re the tshom la gzhan sel med gzhan sel yod na nges par thal rtog pa'ang nges par 'jog pa gzhan sel gyis 'jog pa'i <expan>phyir ro</expan> zhes zer ba de mi rigs te | rtog pa'i gzhan sel <lb n="8b4"/> zhes pa de zhen pa'i sa bon bsal ba 1 dgos saM mngon gyur bsal bas kyang chog | dang po ltar na yid spyod la 'ang gzhan sel <expan>med</expan> par thal zhen pa'i sa bon sel mi nus pa'i <expan>phyir ro</expan> | 2 pa ltar na sgra rtag gaM mi rtag gam zhes ma nges par zhen tsam na nges par zhen pa mngon gyur yod daM <expan>med</expan> | dang po ltar na rtog 2 dus 1 car 'jug par thal | 2 pa ltar <lb n="8b5"/> na gzhan sel med pa <expan>nyams so</expan> des na the tsom la 'ang gzhan sel yod pa <expan>yin no</expan> ||</seg></TEI>
